resources.string: Tailscale remote signing
Sign from CodexCloud using keys on this phone

Connect this app to Tailscale without a system VPN. The agent listens on tailnet port 17373. Only the listed node IDs and selected local RSA signing keys are allowed. Each signature requires approval here. Empty node or key lists deny access. Android 7 or later is required.
